scope: Independent synthetic candidate; no adoption into frozen N30/N120/144 studies

implemented_causal_paths.before: demand multiplies individual production; no order stock or competitor price
implemented_causal_paths.after: orders = base × demand × (competitor_price/own_price)^elasticity × exp(sigma × common_keyed_noise - sigma²/2); FIFO priced contracts expire; price adjusts only after actual work
implemented_causal_paths.parameters: base_orders, elasticity, competitor price, noise, expiry and price response are scenario assumptions
implemented_causal_paths.observables: orders_arrived_units, orders_expired_units, market_price, order_backlog_units; complete begin/end journal

implemented_causal_paths.before: agent production immediately yields proportional cash
implemented_causal_paths.after: original skill/learning/fatigue/cooperation/governance/transition output is bounded by contracts, installed seats and cash-funded materials/logistics; actual efforts scale before work claims, fatigue and learning update
implemented_causal_paths.observables: produced_work_units, effort_hours, enterprise_material_and_logistics_resource_units, productive booking fraction; full raw work records

implemented_causal_paths.after: site shipment ready_day = dispatch_day + declared delay; revenue received only on arrival; cumulative product = delivered + in_transit
implemented_causal_paths.calibration: country costs and transit days are unestimated scenario parameters; no real-company replication

implemented_causal_paths.before: existing paid seat/guild/site expansion uses cash and past revenue/cost signal
implemented_causal_paths.after: same delayed investment controller sees settled revenue, existing recurring cost and material costs; lender uses past margin/backlog/reserve gap, bounded credit and explicit accruing interest
implemented_causal_paths.observables: financing_inflow_resource_units, debt, interest accrued/paid, requested/completed infrastructure, cash
implemented_causal_paths.limits: no bank default/restructuring/capital market equilibrium; credit parameters unestimated

implemented_causal_paths.before: existing construction and hiring-target delays, exits/layoffs, dynamic guild/department/sites and paid recruitment
implemented_causal_paths.after: vacancy-specific recruitment lead plus training lead reserving actual entrant time; original lifespan/leave/fatigue/knowledge loss retained
implemented_causal_paths.observables: entrant times, vacancy stock, training_hours, active/ever people, departments/guild/sites; full checkpoint state
implemented_causal_paths.limits: no explicit applicant pool or migration visa process

implemented_causal_paths.before: department/site counts did not consume productive time
implemented_causal_paths.after: layers = 1 + ceil(log(departments)/log(span)); overload and cross-site context cost reserve agent time before governance/production
implemented_causal_paths.observables: enterprise_coordination_hours, work time, production, fatigue and resulting governance claims
implemented_causal_paths.limits: span/layer formula is hypothesis; no detailed manager assignment/network or cultural psychological coefficients

implemented_causal_paths.before: growth candidate no contextual operational cost path
implemented_causal_paths.after: declared local UTC work window affects production availability, legal cost is cash funded, logistics delays/cost and cross-site communication affect later productivity/cash
implemented_causal_paths.observables: booked context fractions, costs, delays and realized work
implemented_causal_paths.limits: one global company workday remains; no DST/treaty/visa/regulatory completeness. Country labels do not enter individual skills, honesty or random keys

implemented_causal_paths.after: all order/shipment/debt/vacancy/price state in committed header; raw event reconstruction checks consistency of market/credit/growth/attendance/settlements and final summary using shared model transition methods. Separate independent arithmetic and adversarial controls test the three reproduced repair paths, not a second complete economic implementation; exact checkpoint resume and policy fork retain operating state
implemented_causal_paths.observables: source/config/ledger semantic hashes, raw journal, all daily history, complete raw summary checks

validation_machinery.implemented: exclusive frozen role/entity/industry/country/time split; predeclared metrics/scales/weights, parameter grid and all world seeds; calibration-only multi-objective loss, all scores preserved for ambiguous/nonidentifiable fits; local finite-difference rank; frozen evaluation predictions before target read; fixed temporal predictive diagnostics
validation_machinery.actual_controls: synthetic parameter-recovery and access/overlap/source/seed/drift rejection tests only
validation_machinery.actual_observations: only previously exposed official 2022 Amazon headcount excerpt available as diagnostic
validation_machinery.missing: full multi-organization multi-period observed objectives, audited normalizers for revenue/margin, external historical-exposure stewardship, empirical fit, independent cross-enterprise/industry/country holdout, posterior estimation/predictive checks and global identifiability
validation_machinery.strict_boundary: millions of real employees do not identify individual agent traits or a firm's decision process; uncalibrated model resource units are not dollars

not_implemented_in_this_version: multistage supply-chain/task DAG integration from older separate enterprise component
bounds: initial population, endogenous target, installed capacity, ever identities and explicit resource stop caps are separate; no n×2/n×8 growth rule. A declared organizational capacity maximum is a scenario boundary, not an empirical universal ceiling. Reaching resource safety caps refuses execution rather than shortening the horizon.

correctness_repairs.mechanism: calendar settled cash to workday signals
correctness_repairs.before: v2 discarded non-workday receipts and paid interest from the controller signal although cash/ledger were correct
correctness_repairs.after: pending_revenue and pending_operating_cost accumulate each calendar day; eligible workday EWMA consumes the entire pending amount once, then resets; signal half-life remains workday based; decisions use prior signals
correctness_repairs.formula: P_R <- P_R+R_d; P_C <- P_C+C_d; on eligible workday S_R <- S_R+w(P_R-S_R), S_C <- S_C+w(P_C-S_C), P_R=P_C=0; w=1-exp(-ln(2)/half_life_workdays)
correctness_repairs.scope: settled revenue and paid operating/material/logistics costs; financing inflow and one-time recruitment/migration/construction capital outlays are not operating-margin receipts/costs
correctness_repairs.observables: calendar carry stocks, last_cash_observed_day, workday signals; complete checkpoint and raw daily reconstruction

correctness_repairs.before: v2 internal order/debt conservation did not bind delivered_revenue to metrics or last committed operating/growth journal
correctness_repairs.after: cumulative revenue/products/orders/borrowed/material-logistics match independently accumulated metrics; complete operating and growth state plus metrics match last committed day_end; all original full-history raw predicates remain
correctness_repairs.path: LongitudinalEngine.validate_semantics/write_snapshot/restore/validate_persisted_state; ExactLedger.latest_journal_row decodes only last-row fragments; full iter_rows scan remains in raw gate
correctness_repairs.limits: a tail witness does not replace full raw accounting or authenticate an externally modified complete history

correctness_repairs.before: finite individual parameters could still produce overflow at day zero
correctness_repairs.after: log-space bound covers the declared minimum/maximum price, demand <=10, the exact counter-RNG normal envelope sqrt(108 ln2), the full horizon and maximum revenue/material/logistics unit; 16-fold arithmetic headroom; unsafe envelope is rejected without clipping orders
correctness_repairs.limits: numeric representability is not empirical parameter plausibility
